prompt: Show store cities where total revenue in 2022 exceeded 200,000 as a bar chart
sql_query: SELECT st.city, SUM(s.Total_Sale_Value) AS total_revenue FROM sales s JOIN stores st ON s.Store_Number = st.Store_Number WHERE YEAR(s.Sold_Date) = 2022 GROUP BY st.city HAVING SUM(s.Total_Sale_Value) > 200000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
visualization_goal: bar chart of store cities with total 2022 revenue above $200,000, ordered from highest to lowest
